Subject: Marketplace onboarding: PO instructions & evidence for StratoCloud pilot

Hi Neha,

We're preparing to kick off the 30-day pilot for StratoCloud and need to confirm vendor onboarding steps on Redwood's side. Our procurement team has a couple of constraints: they prefer to route the purchase via the AWS Marketplace, but if listing timing is uncertain we need a fallback manual PO path so we can start billing and close the pilot window.

Could you share: 
- The canonical PO template and exact billing email/address Redwood Finance needs for a manual PO (if marketplace listing doesn't clear in time)
- The minimum evidence bundle your Marketplace/legal team requires (SOC reports, DPA, data flow diagram, export controls) to complete vendor activation
- Any marketplace-specific fields that must match on our end (e.g., Seller ID, SKU, Billing contact)

Attaching our standard PO template so you can review how your finance team prefers it filled.

Attachments: PO_Template_StratoCloud.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — Julia Park

Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: PO instructions & evidence for StratoCloud pilot

Julia — thanks for the clear summary. Welcome — excited to get StratoCloud live for the pilot. Quick answers below and a few asks so we can choose the fastest activation path.

Summary of paths (fastest -> more durable):
1) Marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP) — fastest for automated billing once listing is live; requires matching Seller ID and SKU and the marketplace account to be linked to your finance team. Typical lead time: 7–21 days depending on marketplace reviews.
2) Manual PO to Redwood Finance (fallback) — we can accept a signed PO and apply it to your account; requires the PO to include our billing address and Redwood legal name exactly. This is our recommended fallback if listing isn't ready before pilot start.

What I need from you to pick the path:
- Target pilot start date (so we can prioritize listing vs manual PO)
- If manual PO, confirm billing contact and whether StratoCloud needs an invoice recipient different from the marketplace billing contact

Evidence checklist (minimum package to process activation):
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months)
- Signed DPA (we have a template; I can send redlined version)
- Basic network/data flow diagram (PDF)
- Contact for security/pen-test questions (name + email)

I've attached a short checklist I use to route vendor evidence internally — it should help your procurement pack items neatly. If you can get the PO + evidence package over, Vanessa will confirm routing and whether we can apply a temporary billing hold to let the pilot begin while we finish marketplace work.

Attachments: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Neha / Lauren — following up on the routing details you asked for. Finance confirmed the manual fallback flow and the exact PO fields they require: 

Manual PO fallback (Finance requirements):
- Send signed PO to billing@redwood.com and cc finance-ops@redwood.com
- PO must include: Redwood legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Redwood tax ID: 45-6789123; Billing address: 210 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Reference: Deal ID DEAL-7892 and contact email used in HubSpot: procurement+strato@redwood.com
- Payment terms: Net 30 (unless otherwise negotiated)

Temporary activation: Finance can place a temporary invoicing credit (billing hold) for up to 30 days to allow pilot usage while marketplace listing completes. To enable that we need: signed PO + DPA + SOC2 attestation. Once uploaded, finance will issue a confirmation email with an internal reference ID.

Operational notes:
- If marketplace listing completes before our finance posting, we will reconcile and invoice through the marketplace and cancel manual invoices.
- If StratoCloud prefers a single point-of-contact for invoices, include that person and email on the PO; otherwise invoices go to procurement@stratocloud.com.

I'll request the internal reference once we receive the PO. Neha — happy to be the finance liaison on this one.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
